description: Optional 25000-round confirmation of the controlled V6 feature ablation. V6 preserves the class-free 15-entry D4-canonical V5 state and exact global bomb optimum, then adds at most the best safe productive bomb alternative lying strictly before a nearest coin on a globally shortest coin route. Admission has no relative-score threshold. A time-expanded escape search must remain on a shortest spatial route until the coin; if the new blast reaches the coin, the agent must enter it before detonation and leave through a different edge before surviving the complete danger horizon. Reward V3.7 and every learning, seed, checkpoint, and evaluation setting match the V5 25000-round run exactly.
